title: Traditional Algerian Mutton Tagine
description: A classic North African dish made with tender mutton and a blend of aromatic spices. This tagine is slow-cooked to perfection, resulting in a rich and flavorful stew.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add mutton and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add cumin, coriander, and ginger. Cook for 1 minute.
Add harissa and cook for 1 minute.
Add chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Cover and transfer to the oven. Braise for 2 1/2 hours or until the meat is tender.
Add olives and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley.
